payload.text: **Two arms vc will hold WP-02's review to (vc, 2026-09-17).** (1) The body arm that runs .github/workflows/release.yml's own awk must go red when that awk and notes_body diverge by ONE byte -- a trailing blank line is the likely one, so its fixture must end in blank lines. (2) notes_views_check must be shown red on a view stale by ONE line, not only on a missing view. Also for the packet: the contract as sent said notes_views <root> <project>; as built, the project is passed once to notes_select, notes_views and notes_views_check take only the root, and notes_where <version> is added.
